title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, and $I$ an injective resolution of $G$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. A normalized comparison consists of additive equivalences $e_X^q:H^q(I(X))\simeq H^q(X,G)$ and $e_W^q:H^q(I(W))\simeq H^q(W,W^{-1}G)$ for all opens $W$ and degrees $q$. For every cycle $z$ represented by a morphism $f$ from the constant lifted integers, respectively the free abelian sheaf on $W$, the global value is $I.\operatorname{extMk}(f)$ and the open value is the independently defined identity-generator map applied to $I.\operatorname{extMk}(f)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map]. The representing morphism is determined by the constant-sheaf/sections adjunction or the sheafification/free/Yoneda adjunction. No restriction or transfer identity is part of this definition.
